newsitem.title: USA: NY physical coffee - spot supply concerns mounting.
newsitem.headline: NY physical coffee - spot supply concerns mounting.

text.p: New York physical coffee differentials held firm this week, with few scattered sales, as dwindling prompt supply forced roasters to the sidelines, dealers said.

Sharp fluctuations on the nearby CSCE December/March switch, which widened to more than 14 cents earlier this week, and the poor quality of the few spot beans available, made roasters reluctant to buy.
"Roasters are low on inventory, but the cupboards are bare. There are no quality coffees," one trader said. "Business has come to a standstill."

The latest supply data did little to calm frayed nerves. Earlier this week, the CSCE reported U.S. certified coffee stocks fell to only 5,538 60-kg bags in the week ended October 18, with no coffee pending grading.

The drawdown in coffee stocks comes ot a time when exchange and non-exchange consumer stocks housed in U.S. warehouses fell in September to 1,611,000 bags, their lowest level since the Green Coffee Association of New York began tracking inventories in January, 1988.
"It can't get any tighter than it is right now," another trader said. "There are no spot anything. Bleak is the word."
